## Antigravity Command Routing

**IMPORTANT — Read before using `*` commands:**

`*` are **Claude Code slash commands**. They are NOT shell executables.
Do NOT attempt to run them as shell commands (`type project-status`, `which project-status`, etc.) — they will not be found.

**When the user types a `*` command**, look up the corresponding workflow
file at `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/<name>.md` and execute its instructions directly.

| User types | You do |
|---|---|
| `brainstorm` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/brainstorm.md` |
| `shape-spec` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/shape-spec.md` |
| `write-spec` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/write-spec.md` |
| `create-tasks` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/create-tasks.md` |
| `implement-tasks` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/implement-tasks.md` |
| `merge-feature` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/merge-feature.md` |
| `project-status` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/project-status.md` |
| `triage` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/triage.md` |
| `devos-code-review` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/review.md` |
| `test` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/test.md` |
| `commit` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/commit.md` |
| `quick-fix` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/quick-fix.md` |
| `docs-sync` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/docs-sync.md` |
| `gap-analysis` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/gap-analysis.md` |
| `learnings` | Run `~/.gemini/antigravity/workflows/learnings.md` |

For any `*` command without a matching workflow file, describe what the command
does in Claude Code and offer the closest equivalent action.

### codex-cli

# Codex CLI - Current Reference
**Pulled:** 2026-06-16 | **Source:** official OpenAI docs + local CLI help | **Freshness:** live
## Key Patterns
- Installed local CLI reports `codex-cli 0.140.0`; the previous local bundle was `0.137.0` and stale.
- Top-level usage remains `codex [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]` or `codex [OPTIONS] <COMMAND> [ARGS]`.
- Core commands include `exec`, `review`, `login`, `logout`, `mcp`, `plugin`, `mcp-server`, `app-server`, `remote-control`, `completion`, `update`, `doctor`, `sandbox`, `debug`, `apply`, `resume`, `archive`, `delete`, `unarchive`, `fork`, `cloud`, `exec-server`, and `features`.
- Config overrides use `-c, --config <key=value>` with dotted TOML paths. Feature flags can be toggled with `--enable <FEATURE>` and `--disable <FEATURE>`.
- Runtime selection includes `--model`, `--oss`, `--local-provider lmstudio|ollama`, and `--profile <name>`.
- Sandbox modes are `read-only`, `workspace-write`, and `danger-full-access`.
- Approval policies are `untrusted`, `on-request`, `never`, and deprecated `on-failure`.
